messages:
Izzy: FYI seeing a sustained drop in tokens/sec from the coalescer on r4g-prod since ~03:10 UTC. avg tokens/sec down ~22% vs baseline.
Mike: ugh. any correlation with KV cache hitrate?
Izzy: initial look - kv_cache.hit_rate is roughly flat, but batch_utilization is down and queue_depth variance spiked. perf-bot alert fired about 03:12.
perf-bot: [ALERT] regression detected: coalescer.tokens_per_sec decreased >15% (r4g-prod). report: https://perf.redwood/reports/2026-03-17-01
Sana: can you paste the queries you used so we can reproduce the dashboards?
Izzy: sure. ran these on telemetry-prod: 
```
avg_over_time(coalescer_tokens_per_sec[5m])
coalesce_batch_utilization{env="prod"}
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(coalesce_batch_size_bucket[5m])) by (le))
rate(kv_cache_hits_total[1m]) / rate(kv_cache_requests_total[1m])
```
But the real anomaly is the batch_size distribution shifting to many small batches (mode around 1-2).
Devon: could be the queue policy releasing early under backpressure. any kernel/autotune fallbacks at that window? we had a fallback to generic kernels when memory pressure spiked last week.
Izzy: checked kernel_selector logs: several workers logged `fallback_to_generic=true reason=kv_miss_backpressure` around 03:08-03:09 (see excerpt).
Izzy: ```
2026-03-17T03:08:12Z kernel_selector.cpp:142 warn fallback_to_generic=true reason=kv_miss_backpressure worker=ip-10-0-5-23
2026-03-17T03:09:03Z kernel_selector.cpp:142 info selected_kernel=generic worker=ip-10-0-3-11
```
Priya: I can run a local synthetic with tokenflow-synth and KV miss patterns. starting: `tokenflow-synth --burst=1000 --kv-miss-rate=0.35 --duration=15m` and will upload a flamegraph.
Sana: dashboard action items: add p90 tokens/sec per-worker, batch_size histogram (live), queue_duration_seconds p50/p95, and kv_cache_hitrate heatmap. Also add an alert rule: sustained coalesce_batch_utilization < 0.5 for 10m.
Devon: also surface kernel_choice metrics: `kernel_choice_total{path="generic"}` and `kernel_queue_delay_ms` so we can see fallbacks and queuing inside kernel selector.
Mike: I'll open a quick dashboard PR with panel JSON and suggested PromQL. also adding a canary rule to prefer compact kernels when avg_seq_len < 128 to avoid generic fallbacks.
Izzy: short term: alert + dashboard. medium term: change coalescer queue policy so it avoids prematurely releasing tiny batches when KV backpressure is present; maybe hold up to X ms or until min_batch_size unless queue depth exceeds threshold.
Priya: started local run, uploading profile: https://artifacts.redwood/fg/1754449876.html (flamegraph). early look shows KV lock contention on `coalesce::enqueue()` path.
Devon: checking lock counts now. if contention high we might need finer-grained locking or async KV checks. will post thread with findings in ~45m. :mag:
ops-bot: deploy-status: patch `coalesce-queue-policy v0.9.3` created, canary scheduled to staging. link: https://deploys.redwood/coalesce-queue-policy/0.9.3
Mike: once we have the dashboard we should correlate kernel_choice fallbacks against batch size histogram to prove causality.
Izzy: agreed. thanks all — prioritize the dashboard + alert this morning, then queue-policy tweak as follow-up. :thumbsup:
